mapper.select: SELECT NOTICE_NO as notice_no, TITLE as title, CONTENT as content, WRITER as writer, BOARD_TYPE as board_type, COUNT as count, IS_REPLY as is_reply, PARENT_NO as parent_no, TO_CHAR(INDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as indate FROM BOARD WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{notice_no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, BOARD_TYPE, PARENT_NO, IS_REPLY) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{board_type}, #{parent_no}, #{is_reply})
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET COUNT = COUNT + 1 WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{notice_no}
